groups.operation: Normalize text with CHARBOUND and STRIPCC.
groups.condition: A stripped control and surviving text have boundary markers.
groups.capability: Retain CHARBOUND markers for surviving text and remove the marker before the control removed by STRIPCC.
groups.consequence: The combined marker behavior is not exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same combined marker retention and removal behavior.

groups.operation: Normalize text with NLF2LS and without STRIPCC.
groups.condition: Input contains LF and an unrelated tab.
groups.capability: Convert LF to U+2028 while preserving the tab.
groups.consequence: This option combination is not exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same LF conversion and control preservation behavior.

groups.operation: Map text with CHARBOUND and STRIPCC.
groups.consequence: The retained grapheme loses its boundary marker.
groups.equivalence_reason: This candidate focuses on marker preservation.

groups.operation: Map text with CHARBOUND and STRIPCC.
groups.condition: STRIPCC removes a control preceded by a CHARBOUND sentinel.
groups.capability: Remove that control's sentinel while retaining markers for surviving graphemes.
groups.consequence: A marker for the removed control remains.
groups.equivalence_reason: This candidate focuses on selective removal of the stripped control's marker.

groups.condition: An out-of-range entry separates composable codepoints.
groups.capability: Preserve the entry and prevent composition across it.
groups.equivalence_reason: No other candidate describes this UTF-32 composition behavior.

groups.operation: Call utf8proc_map with an explicit input length.
groups.condition: Valid UTF-8 bytes follow an embedded NUL within that length.
groups.capability: Process the bytes after the NUL.
groups.consequence: Those bytes are excluded from mapping.
groups.equivalence_reason: No other candidate describes explicit-length processing after an embedded NUL.
